senses.gloss: m.(b. h. שֵׁרוֹת pl.; preced.) chain, necklace, bracelet, ring.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:1">Sabb. V, 1</cite> <he>סוס בש׳</he> the horse may be let out (on the Sabbath) with his chain (or ring); <he>וכל בעלי הש׳ וכ׳</he> and all chain-wearing animals &c.; Tosef. ib. IV (V), 4.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 25a:14">B. Mets. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כש׳</he> if the coins found lie arranged like a ring (or necklace).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:13">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ</cite> top <he>ובלבד … לא בש׳ וכ׳</he> save that he does not put it (the amulet) in a necklace or a signet ring; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="U01080"><he>שֵׁירִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:18">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>וחיו משליכות עליו ש׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="U01078"><he>שיריין</he></cite>) and they (the Egyptian women) threw at him (Joseph) chains and necklaces &c.
